description: This file provides utility functions for handling Excel cell references and date conversions, ported from Perl's Spreadsheet::WriteExcel to PHP. It includes functions to convert between row/column notation and A1 notation, manipulate cell references, and handle Excel date calculations.

methods.name: xl_rowcol_to_cell
methods.description: Converts zero-based row and column to Excel A1 cell notation, with optional absolute references.

methods.name: xl_cell_to_rowcol
methods.description: Parses an Excel A1 cell notation string and returns zero-based row and column indices along with absolute reference flags.

methods.name: xl_inc_row
methods.description: Increments the row part of a cell reference.

methods.name: xl_dec_row
methods.description: Decrements the row part of a cell reference.

methods.name: xl_inc_col
methods.description: Increments the column part of a cell reference.

methods.name: xl_dec_col
methods.description: Decrements the column part of a cell reference.

methods.name: xl_date_list
methods.description: Generates an Excel serial date number from provided date and time components, accounting for leap years and Excel's date system.

methods.name: xl_parse_time
methods.description: Parses a time string into an Excel fractional day value.

methods.name: xl_parse_date
methods.description: Converts a date string into an Excel serial date number.

methods.name: xl_parse_date_init
methods.description: Placeholder function; does nothing but exists for compatibility.

methods.name: xl_decode_date_EU
methods.description: Decodes a date string assuming European format; internally calls xl_parse_date.

methods.name: xl_decode_date_US
methods.description: Decodes a date string assuming US format; internally calls xl_parse_date.

methods.name: xl_date_1904
methods.description: Adjusts an Excel date serial number for the 1904 date system if applicable.
